before.title: Anti-GBM disease
before.diseaseDescription: Bounded anti-GBM autoimmunity to alpha3/alpha5 type IV collagen NC1 epitopes, HLA-restricted T-cell responses, antibody-mediated renal and pulmonary injury; human observations and experimental models remain distinct. Excludes Alport post-transplant nephritis and atypical seronegative disease.
before.releaseNote: Initial bounded agent-curated candidate using nine selected primary reports. Abstract access predominates; human findings and experimental systems are labelled. Independent domain review and calibration pending. Not a systematic review.

after.title: Anti-GBM disease
after.diseaseDescription: Bounded anti-GBM autoimmunity to alpha3/alpha5 type IV collagen NC1 epitopes, HLA-restricted T-cell responses, antibody-mediated renal and pulmonary injury; human observations and experimental models remain distinct. Excludes Alport post-transplant nephritis and atypical seronegative disease.
after.releaseNote: Bounded agent-curated anti-GBM map with separate human, biochemical, mouse, rat and monkey views. Selected therapies retain uncontrolled phase 2 and null phase 3 outcome distinctions. Abstract access predominates. Scientific review, calibration and full trial-result appraisal remain pending.

before.text: Patient kidney/lung-bound autoantibodies recognized α3NC1 and α5NC1 monomers in antigen-specificity assays.
limitations: Binding specificity does not show equal pathogenic contribution of α3 and α5 antibodies; Alport comparators are excluded as mapped disease.

after.text: Patient kidney/lung-bound autoantibodies recognized α3NC1 and α5NC1 monomers in antigen-specificity assays.
limitations: Binding specificity does not show equal pathogenic contribution of α3 and α5 antibodies; Alport comparators are excluded as mapped disease.

before.text: C3 or C4 deficiency reduced proteinuria and capillary thrombosis in heterologous anti-GBM nephritis.
limitations: Dose-sensitive model effect; protection was overcome by increased antibody dose.

after.text: C3 or C4 deficiency reduced proteinuria and capillary thrombosis in heterologous anti-GBM nephritis.
limitations: Dose-sensitive model effect; protection was overcome by increased antibody dose.

before.text: C3- or C4-deficient mice had reduced early glomerular neutrophil infiltration after heterologous anti-GBM antibody challenge.
limitations: Heterologous acute model; not direct evidence for complement blockade in human anti-GBM disease.

after.text: C3- or C4-deficient mice had reduced early glomerular neutrophil infiltration after heterologous anti-GBM antibody challenge.
limitations: Heterologous acute model; not direct evidence for complement blockade in human anti-GBM disease.

before.text: Factor B and C5b-9 staining was stronger in glomeruli with crescents than in glomeruli without crescents.
limitations: Small observational biopsy study with glomeruli nested within patients; not proof of complement-caused crescents.

after.text: Factor B and C5b-9 staining was stronger in glomeruli with crescents than in glomeruli without crescents.
limitations: Small observational biopsy study with glomeruli nested within patients; not proof of complement-caused crescents.

before.text: In biochemical assays, the native cross-linked α345NC1 hexamer concealed antibody-reactive conformations present on α3NC1/α5NC1 monomers.
limitations: Does not establish the initiating in-vivo trigger or prove that hexamer disruption precedes human disease.

after.text: In biochemical assays, the native cross-linked α345NC1 hexamer concealed antibody-reactive conformations present on α3NC1/α5NC1 monomers.
limitations: Does not establish the initiating in-vivo trigger or prove that hexamer disruption precedes human disease.

before.text: Anti-GBM renal biopsies showed complement components along GBM, including classical and alternative-pathway components.
limitations: Tissue colocalization does not establish pathway ordering or complement dependence in each patient; two patients were MPO-ANCA positive.

after.text: Anti-GBM renal biopsies showed complement components along GBM, including classical and alternative-pathway components.
limitations: Tissue colocalization does not establish pathway ordering or complement dependence in each patient; two patients were MPO-ANCA positive.

before.text: Increasing nephritogenic antibody dose overcame the protective effect of complement deficiency.
limitations: Qualifies absolute complement dependence; cannot be used as positive evidence that complement is always necessary.

after.text: Increasing nephritogenic antibody dose overcame the protective effect of complement deficiency.
limitations: Qualifies absolute complement dependence; cannot be used as positive evidence that complement is always necessary.

before.text: In HLA-DR15 transgenic mice, α3 peptide presentation selected pro-inflammatory conventional α3-specific T-cell responses.
limitations: Abstract-level mouse mechanism; not all human HLA-DR15 carriers develop anti-GBM disease.

after.text: In HLA-DR15 transgenic mice, α3 peptide presentation selected pro-inflammatory conventional α3-specific T-cell responses.
limitations: Abstract-level mouse mechanism; not all human HLA-DR15 carriers develop anti-GBM disease.

after.text: KDIGO 2021 recommends combined plasma exchange, cyclophosphamide and glucocorticoids for anti-GBM GN, with a severe irreversible-renal-injury exception in the absence of pulmonary haemorrhage.
limitations: Guideline recommendation 1C; not a component-specific randomized efficacy estimate or regulatory approval.

before.text: Double-positive patients shared severe renal disease and frequent lung haemorrhage at presentation with anti-GBM disease.
limitations: Overlap link to ANCA-associated vasculitis only; not evidence that ANCA causes anti-GBM antibodies.

after.text: Double-positive patients shared severe renal disease and frequent lung haemorrhage at presentation with anti-GBM disease.
limitations: Overlap link to ANCA-associated vasculitis only; not evidence that ANCA causes anti-GBM antibodies.

before.text: Patients with Goodpasture disease displayed clonally expanded α3-specific CD4 T-cell repertoires.
limitations: Expansion in patients does not establish that T cells alone caused their renal injury.

after.text: Patients with Goodpasture disease displayed clonally expanded α3-specific CD4 T-cell repertoires.
limitations: Expansion in patients does not establish that T cells alone caused their renal injury.

before.text: In the 15-adult one-arm phase 2a trial, anti-GBM antibody levels were below the assay reference range six hours after imlifidase.
limitations: Uncontrolled phase 2a study; antibody depletion is a pharmacodynamic endpoint, not proof of added clinical benefit; six patients also ANCA positive.

after.text: In the 15-adult one-arm phase 2a trial, anti-GBM antibody levels were below the assay reference range six hours after imlifidase.
limitations: Uncontrolled phase 2a study; antibody depletion is a pharmacodynamic endpoint, not proof of added clinical benefit; six patients also ANCA positive.

before.text: Ten of fifteen phase 2a participants were dialysis independent at six months, compared with nine of fifty historical controls.
limitations: Historical comparison subject to selection and care differences; later randomized phase 3 sponsor report found no significant primary-endpoint benefit.

after.text: Ten of fifteen phase 2a participants were dialysis independent at six months, compared with nine of fifty historical controls.
limitations: Historical comparison subject to selection and care differences; later randomized phase 3 sponsor report found no significant primary-endpoint benefit.

before.text: Complement was required for full anti-GBM antibody-induced haemorrhagic lung injury in rats.
limitations: Same study as neutrophil lung result, not independent replication; acute model.

after.text: Complement was required for full anti-GBM antibody-induced haemorrhagic lung injury in rats.
limitations: Same study as neutrophil lung result, not independent replication; acute model.

before.text: Neutrophils were required for full haemorrhagic lung injury after anti-GBM antibody infusion in rats.
limitations: Rat lung injury model; does not establish sufficiency of the same pathway in human alveolar haemorrhage.

after.text: Neutrophils were required for full haemorrhagic lung injury after anti-GBM antibody infusion in rats.
limitations: Rat lung injury model; does not establish sufficiency of the same pathway in human alveolar haemorrhage.

before.text: After α3 peptide immunization, α3-specific T cells infiltrated kidneys and HLA-DR15 transgenic mice developed disease.
limitations: Induced disease model; antibody-independent injury is not established by this abstract passage.

after.text: After α3 peptide immunization, α3-specific T cells infiltrated kidneys and HLA-DR15 transgenic mice developed disease.
limitations: Induced disease model; antibody-independent injury is not established by this abstract passage.

after.text: The sponsor reported that randomized GOOD-IDES-02 did not meet its six-month eGFR primary endpoint; responses were similar with imlifidase plus standard care and standard care alone.
limitations: Sponsor topline, not independently appraised full trial data; no significant superiority demonstrated.
Report has a conflicting year in one footer; header/lead and Cision distribution date support 2025-12-16.

before.text: Anti-GBM antibodies were identified in sera/kidneys and bound host glomeruli in the reported human cases.
limitations: Historical selected cases; modern prevalence, diagnosis and transplantation inferences from this report are not adopted.

before.text: Transfer of serum or renal-eluate IgG from three anti-GBM patients produced acute glomerulonephritis in recipient monkeys.
limitations: Passive transfer supports antibody pathogenicity in recipients; it does not explain human autoimmunity initiation.

after.text: Transfer of serum or renal-eluate IgG from three anti-GBM patients produced acute glomerulonephritis in recipient monkeys.

before.text: HLA-DR1-induced regulatory T cells conferred resistance to induced disease in HLA-DR15/DR1 transgenic mice.
limitations: Protective model branch; this does not demonstrate clinical Treg therapy efficacy.
